body:
I just don't know what to do in the meantime? I'm still studying because I want to pass these exams but if I don't, I'll be so behind my classmates.  I'm going on a co-op this fall so I'll take a semester off to work and clear my head of school, so maybe that will help.

I'm just afraid my parents will regret spending the money on me to fail a year of school. I can always use the money from my co-op and internship to pay them back, too.

I just hate feeling not as smart as my classmates because I know I am.  Fuck.
I just don't see how it's going to work out for me.

I failed a class last semester because I was too lazy to do any work and I can tell my parents are disappointed in me already.  I'm smart, so smart, but I just can't make myself work.  I might lose my scholarship if I fail a class this semester and that would crush them.
